Claim 1 (Currently amended): A system for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: __a processor configured to__ analyze the network data and identify a malicious network threat; and perform a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The system of claim 1, wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to push a notification including the mitigating action for the malicious network threat to a third party device __over a secure communication channel__.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): A method for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: retrieving __network data from a secure source__ associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain; analyzing the network data and identifying a malicious network threat; and performing a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The method of claim 10, further comprising pushing a notification including the mitigating action for the malicious network threat to a third party device __over a secure communication channel__.
